content.enriched_brief: Create a cultivation-rebirth animated short drama. The protagonist, a young man with long dark hair and traditional white and blue clothing, was once the Heavenly Emperor who suppressed all under heaven, killed by the joint betrayal of nine sacred lands. He is now reborn into the body of the trash junior disciple whom every senior in the sect mocks; every one of those who once stepped on him has no idea they are already standing at the edge of doom.
